decisions.reason: The panel-control mappings and BOOT-button placement from message 320 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY Event.
The GPIO assignments entailed by message 320 are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY Event; the message does not resolve the separate SPI MOSI ambiguity.
Identifying the TTP223 panel connectors and their GPIO assignments does not change the existing standalone-power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered scope.
The panel-connector mapping does not alter the main-board decoupling requirement.
The source message does not change the INA219 monitor or the monitored 3.3V rail.
The panel-button, switch, reset, and touch mappings do not affect the addressable LEDs' supply, switching, or logic-level handling.
The source decision does not modify the power sources, OR-ing method, diode requirement, or source-selection behavior.
The panel-connector mapping contains no change to I2C series-resistor value, population policy, purpose, or topology.
The source message does not discuss or change the battery-charge indicator, GPIO13, J_LED_CHG, or related resistor and population settings.
The mapped connectors are panel controls and inputs, not the interboard power or signal connectors; their pinouts and unresolved physical power-pin numbering remain unchanged.
The main-board panel-connector mapping does not affect the power-board battery connector, pin functions, placement, or electrical destination.
The source message specifies main-board panel controls and GPIO mappings and does not change the power-board dimensions, mounting, connector arrangement, or enclosure fit.
